items.title: TabSOM：基于自组织映射的表格到图像编码方法
items.originalTitle: TabSOM: A tabular-to-image encoding method based on self-organizing maps
items.summary: TabSOM是一种基于自组织映射（SOM）的表格到图像编码方法，为每个输入特征提供固定画布位置（通过无冲突匈牙利分配），并捕获特征间关系。生成的图像堆叠两个多尺度节点通道，分别编码特征值和特征交互。在12种方法基准测试中，TabSOM在每个数据集上排名第一或第二，方差最低，并提供可解释性工具。

They convert tabular data into image representations, mapping each feature at a fixed pixel location derived from a dimensionality-reduction method (e.g., t-SNE, UMAP, PCA). However, they encode only the marginal value of each feature and discard information about feature relationships. We propose TabSOM, a tabular-to-image encoding built on the Self-Organi…
keyFacts: 如何改进表格到图像编码以保留特征关系并提高下游性能？
使用SOM组件平面和匈牙利分配生成空间布局，结合多尺度节点通道，并引入基于SOM的可解释性方法。

items.originalTitle: Concept Drift Detection and Adaptive Retraining of Malware Classification Models
items.summary: 概念漂移指数据统计特性随时间变化，导致恶意软件检测模型性能下降。本文分析基于OCSVM的新方法和基于Minibatch K-Means的已有方法，并与MMD比较。对四种学习模型（MLP、RF、SVM、XGBoost）在静态、周期和漂移感知场景下实验，用Pareto前沿分析精度与训练效率。结果表明所有检测技术达到与周期再训练相当的精度，且效率更高，其中OCSVM方法通常优于其他。
items.abstract: Concept drift refers to changes over time in the statistical properties of data, as compared to the data that was used to train a learning model. Machine learning models for malware detection or classification are particularly susceptible to performance degradation caused by concept drift, as attackers constantly modify existing malware. In this chapter, we analyze two machine learning-based approaches to automated concept drift detection-a novel approach based on One-Class Support Vector Machines (OCSVM) and a pr…
keyFacts: 如何准确检测恶意软件分类中的概念漂移并实现高效的模型再训练？
比较OCSVM、MK-Means和MMD三种漂移检测方法，对MLP、RF、SVM和XGBoost在静态、周期和漂移感知场景下进行实验，并用Pareto前沿分析。

items.originalTitle: LLM-Assisted Dynamic Threat Analysis for Attacker-Reachable Software Weaknesses in Autonomous Vehicles
items.summary: 自动驾驶车辆依赖安全关键的软件栈，静态分析可识别候选弱点但动态验证困难。本文研究LLM能否自动化该过程。对Autoware进行编译器精确静态分析，识别决策规则、验证检查和输入到安全输出流，生成3700个工件集，在真实构建下编译、修复和模糊测试。结果显示80%的首次编译失败源于依赖连接而非逻辑；推理模型首次编译成功率64%，代码专用模型仅6%；修复后仅推理模型达到完全可编译，但少于一半进入模糊测试，所有崩溃源于桩代码。未确认任何弱点。构建集成是主要障碍。
items.abstract: Autonomous vehicles depend on large safety-critical software stacks, where weaknesses reachable from adversarial inputs may affect steering, braking, or other control decisions. Many ROI interfaces rely on external spatial labels, such as gaze, object classes, or affordance annotations. Label-free alternatives often derive crops from trajectories by detecting gripper or motion events and centering a fixed crop at the projected end-effector. Such action-derived crops are useful spatial priors that require no additional labels…

Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) learns from reward differences within each rollout group. When all sampled trajectories are poor, this relative signal can rank failures without identifying behavior outside the failed region. items.summary: LHS 1140 b是寻找系外行星大气的重要目标，其大小和轨道周期暗示可能存在大气。地基观测曾探测到亚稳态氦三重态，暗示存在氦逃逸，但后续观测未再次探测到。本研究利用2023至2026年间四次JWST NIRISS/SOSS观测，均未探测到氦吸收，且以大于3σ的置信度排斥地基最佳拟合模型，未发现质量损失随时间变化的清晰趋势。结果提示地基探测可能为虚假信号，但若氦吸收出现在少于50%的凌星中，则无法排除可变性。
items.abstract: In the effort to determine which low-mass exoplanets have atmospheres, LHS 1140 b remains one of the most favorable targets. Its large size (5.6 $\rm M_{\oplus}$ and 1.7 $\rm R_{\oplus}$) and relatively long orbital period (24.7 days) imply an atmosphere may be likely, and notably, recent interior models favor either a hydrogen-dominated "mini-Neptune" or a "water world" over a true terrestrial planet. Another possibility is that it has a helium-rich atmosphere. This hypothesis is supported by recent ground-based…
keyFacts: LHS 1140 b是否具有富氦大气，以及地基探测到的氦吸收是否可靠？
使用JWST NIRISS/SOSS在2023至2026年间进行四次凌星观测，覆盖亚稳态氦三重态，并与地基观测时期对应，对氦吸收进行敏感性检测。
四次观测均未探测到氦吸收，每次观测以大于3σ的置信度拒绝地基最佳拟合模型，且未发现质量损失随时间变化的清晰趋势。

items.title: 四次JWST NIRISS凌星对LHS 1140 b氦吸收的严格限制
items.originalTitle: Strict Limits on Helium Absorption from LHS 1140 b from Four JWST NIRISS Transits
items.summary: 围绕宜居带行星LHS 1140 b，近期研究声称探测到亚稳态氦逃逸，暗示其大气富氦贫氢。本研究分析四次JWST NIRISS凌星数据，均不支持氦吸收，与平坦连续谱的几率比在3.9至11.6之间；对于类似声称的振幅和宽度的氦吸收，几率比高达300至8.6×10^4比1，强烈排除。但JWST凌星与声称的探测并非同时。此外，拟合四次日外光谱及另一颗行星c的凌星，未发现恒星变异性证据。研究为氦逃逸提供了严格限制。
items.abstract: Orbiting in the habitable zone of its host star, the 1.7 $R_\oplus$, 5.6 $M_\oplus$ planet LHS 1140 b is a target of great interest. Recently Cherubim et al. (2026) published a detection of metastable He escaping from the atmosphere of LHS 1140 b, simultaneously providing the first concrete inference of an atmosphere on this planet and indicating that the atmosphere is He-rich and H-poor as would be expected due to Gyrs of fractionated mass loss. keyFacts: JWST NIRISS四次凌星观测是否支持LHS 1140 b存在氦吸收？
分析四次JWST NIRISS凌星数据，对比平坦连续谱计算几率比，并拟合绝对出凌恒星光谱及额外的一次凌星以检查恒星变异性。
四次访问均不支持氦吸收，几率比3.9-11.6:1；强烈排除声称的氦吸收信号，几率比300至8.6×10^4:1；恒星光谱参数一致，未发现变异性证据。

items.title: JWST MIRI中分辨率光谱仪点固定模式校正：更干净、更高信噪比的点源光谱
items.originalTitle: JWST MIRI Medium Resolution Spectrometer Point Fixed Pattern Corrections: Cleaner and Higher Signal-to-Noise Spectra of Point Sources
items.summary: JWST中红外仪器中分辨率光谱仪可获取5-28微米光谱，但现有管道校正后仍存在固定模式噪声限制信噪比。本研究基于前期工作，利用O、A、G矮星和标准小行星的观测构建点固定模式校正，应用于采用同样抖动模式的目标获取点源光谱。校正可单独或与残差条纹校正结合，移除窄和宽伪影，显著提高信噪比，最高可达1000以上。提供MRS-PFPC Python包供使用。
items.abstract: The JWST Mid-Infrared Instrument Medium Resolution Spectrometer provides the capability to obtain spectra from 5-28 micron. The JWST data reduction pipeline removes the majority but not all of the instrument artifacts and the signal-to-noise (S/N) of the resulting spectra are limited by fixed pattern noise. Building on previous work, Point Fixed Pattern Corrections (PFPCs) are constructed using observations of O, A, and G dwarf flux calibration stars and asteroids taken using the default four point dither pattern…
keyFacts: 如何改善JWST MIRI中分辨率光谱仪点源光谱的信噪比，去除固定模式噪声？
利用标准星和小行星观测构建点固定模式校正（PFPCs），应用于点源光谱，并与残差条纹校正结合使用。
PFPCs能移除窄和宽伪影，显著提高信噪比，高信噪比观测可提升数倍，信噪比可达1000以上。

items.title: 非周期性足以实现宏观热化
items.originalTitle: Aperiodicity is sufficient for macroscopic thermalization
items.summary: 本研究识别了宏观可观测量有限时间热化的一般机制，基于量子动力学的两个基本要素：非周期性提供可计算度量，以及动力学的部分遍历性探索。该机制仅需初始态系综的返回概率在有限时间范围内很小，即能预测几乎所有宏观可观测量的平衡，几乎所有初始态和时间。作为特例，它也涵盖了无限长时间热化的标准结果。结果将宏观热化纳入操作量子统计力学范畴，建立可计算判据与热化之间的联系。
items.abstract: We identify a general mechanism for the finite-time thermalization of macroscopic observables, such as coarse-grained charge densities, in terms of elementary forms of the quantum dynamics of initial states: (1) aperiodicity, which provides a computable measure of (2) a dynamical partially ergodic exploration of the Hilbert space. Specifically, this mechanism predicts the equilibration of all (concentrated) macroscopic observables, in almost all states in an initial ensemble and almost all times within finite and…
keyFacts: 宏观系统在有限时间内热化的充分条件是什么？
利用非周期性作为可计算度量，结合动力学的部分遍历性，基于初始态系综的返回概率小，推导宏观可观测量的平衡。
非周期性足以导致宏观热化，预测几乎所有可观测量在几乎所有时间和初始态下平衡，并包含无限时间热化作为特例。

items.title: 基于交叉注意力潜在稀疏专家的细粒度动作识别
items.originalTitle: Fine-Grained Action Recognition with Cross-Attentive Latent Sparse Experts
items.summary: 细粒度人体动作识别需区分外观相似但身体配置、时序或局部外观不同的动作。本文提出FineX，将细粒度线索分解为RGB外观、姿态热图几何和骨骼图拓扑，通过成对交叉注意力进行对称信息交换，并使用流式潜在稀疏专家混合路由每个表示到内容相关子集，由负载平衡目标正则化。FineX在Gym99、Gym288和Diving48上取得最佳性能，在长尾Gym288上平均类准确率提高7.6个百分点，且无需文本监督或大规模视觉语言预训练。
items.abstract: Fine-grained human action recognition (FHAR) must distinguish visually similar actions that differ mainly in body configuration, timing, or local appearance. RGB representations retain visual context but often suppress joint-level geometry, whereas skeleton representations encode kinematics but discard dense spatial detail. We introduce FineX, which factorizes fine-grained cues into RGB appearance, pose heatmap geometry, and skeletal-graph topology. Pairwise cross-attention enables symmetric, stream-preserving inf…
keyFacts: 如何利用多模态信息（RGB、姿态、骨骼）提升细粒度动作识别的性能？
FineX方法：分解RGB、姿态热图和骨骼图，使用成对交叉注意力进行信息交换，并采用流式潜在稀疏专家混合与负载平衡正则化。
在Gym99、Gym288和Diving48上取得最佳结果，Gym288平均类准确率从68.6%提升至76.2%（+7.6），无需文本监督或预训练。
